description: This file, FeedbackDBUtil.java, is a Java class responsible for database operations related to Feedback data in the online grocery ordering system. It provides methods to retrieve all feedback records and insert new feedback entries, interacting with the database via SQL queries and utilizing external database utility methods.
external_files: webDB (assumed to be a database utility class with executeSearch and executeIUD methods)

classes.name: FeedbackDBUtil
classes.description: A utility class for database operations related to Feedback objects within the system.

methods.name: getAllFeedbacks
methods.description: Retrieves all feedback records from the database and returns them as a list of Feedback objects.

methods.name: insertFeedback
methods.description: Inserts a new feedback record into the database with provided comments, rating, and OID.
